steps: Some postcards are books, all books novels -> some postcards are novels (I true)
II: cards could be books? Not forced either way, not definite
III: all cards novels not forced
check_code:
from itertools import product
# types: (card,post,book,novel) membership booleans; enumerate universe subsets of types
types=[t for t in product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[2] or t[3])]
import itertools
def models():
    for r in range(1,len(types)+1):
        for S in itertools.combinations(types,r):
            if any(t[1] and t[2] for t in S):
                yield S
c1=lambda S:any(t[1] and t[3] for t in S)
c2=lambda S:not any(t[0] and t[2] for t in S)
c3=lambda S:all((not t[0]) or t[3] for t in S)
res=[all(c(S) for S in models()) for c in (c1,c2,c3)]
assert res==[True,False,False]
opts={'A':(0,1,1),'B':(1,1,0),'C':(1,0,0),'D':(0,0,1)}
ans=tuple(int(x) for x in res)
assert opts['C']==ans and all(opts[k]!=ans for k in 'ABD')
